explanation: The theorem is a very specific uniqueness statement. Under a local midpoint (Brunn–Minkowski-type) ball-measure comparison hypothesis, two density limits of a finite absolutely continuous measure at nearby points x and y of Euclidean space must be equal. Its proof is just le_antisymm applied to the library's own lemma local_midpoint_density_le, which is not a Mathlib declaration. I did not find anything in Mathlib that matches. The nearest Mathlib material is the Lebesgue differentiation theorem (the measure-ball ratio limit) and general measure-ball lemmas. None of it states or implies this midpoint-density comparison. I did not run an exhaustive grep.
